SELECT NOW()::text AS captured_at,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM accounts WHERE id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000001') AS accounts,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM users WHERE id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000002' OR account_id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000001') AS users,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM businesses WHERE id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000011' OR account_id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000001') AS businesses,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM agent_conversations WHERE id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000031' OR account_id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000001') AS conversations,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM agent_turns WHERE id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000032' OR client_turn_key='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000033' OR account_id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000001') AS turns,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM job_outbox WHERE id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000034' OR aggregate_id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000032' OR payload->>'account_id'='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000001') AS outboxes,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM agent_proposals WHERE account_id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000001') AS proposals,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM api_costs WHERE account_id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000001') AS costs,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM agent_runs WHERE account_id='019f43d1-0000-7000-8000-000000000001') AS runs,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM auth.users WHERE email='run-d-rollback-bd23d56e@e2e.repworth.net') AS auth_users;
